title: MUB(6) Wall Atlas node ledger
description: Typed memory of verified progress. Nodes earn atlas points: non-financial, non-transferable, artifact-linked, evidence-weighted, and revocable if a claim is broken.

scope.description: which board/region of MUB(6) this covers

artifact.description: module / file paths the node points to

verifier.description: command or path that re-checks it, or "none"

independent_reruns.description: reruns of the verifier by parties other than the author (5 atlas points each). DERIVED: must equal the length of the 'reruns' evidence list; the scorer rejects any hand-set value that does not match its evidence.

independent_implementations.description: from-scratch reimplementations in another system (13 atlas points each). DERIVED: must equal the length of the 'implementations' evidence list.

reruns.description: one checkable entry per independent verifier rerun; 'independent_reruns' is derived from its length

evidence.description: the checkable artifact: a URL, commit, log, or path a stranger can inspect

sha256.description: optional content hash of the evidence

implementations.description: one checkable entry per independent reimplementation; 'independent_implementations' is derived from its length

bundle_doi.description: Version-specific DOI of the exact deposit this node was verified against (optional, pins exactly what was checked)

concept_doi.description: Concept (all-versions) DOI that always resolves to the latest deposit (optional, the never-stale citation for the work)

certificate_sha256.description: sha256 of the exact certificate artifact, where the node IS a certificate (optional byte-binding)

certificate_sha256_of.description: exactly what certificate_sha256 is the hash of, so a stranger can reconcile it (optional)

certificate_recompute.description: the command that reproduces certificate_sha256 from the bundle (optional)
